title: canonical registry 默认集中治理，AI Trader 默认逻辑隔离；物理分库作为例外

metadata.classification_notes: 本条主归属 AI Engineering / Database Storage。它不规定交易本体，而是约束 canonical registry、audit ledger 与 AI Trader unit 逻辑隔离的关系。

applies_when: 外接项目需要管理多个 AI Trader、Unit、策略版本、训练集版本或模型版本
需要审计 dataset、feature schema、label policy、readiness、promotion 和回滚链路
需要防止向量库、日志片段、临时文件或 notebook 输出成为事实主库
not_applicable_when: 只讨论离线一次性实验且不进入训练、评估、发布、审计或外部项目复用
用户要求真实数据库 DDL、分片方案、云服务选型或成本估算
用户要求交易信号、买卖点、仓位、杠杆、止损止盈或实盘执行建议

content.statement: Trading AI 项目应默认保留中央 canonical registry / audit ledger 作为 unit、dataset、manifest、feature schema、audit trace、readiness 和 lineage 的事实索引与治理入口。AI Trader、Unit 或策略版本默认通过 unit_id、unit_version、strategy_id、strategy_version 等字段逻辑隔离；当合规隔离、客户密钥、监管边界、地域隔离、超大规模或运维约束成立时，可以采用物理分库、schema 隔离或 hybrid pool/silo/bridge 架构，但必须保留全局索引、跨库 lineage reconciliation 和 audit trace。向量库、cache、日志片段或临时文件不得替代 canonical registry / audit ledger。
content.rationale: 本条不是数据库部署命令，不创建真实数据库，不强制单体库或分布式库；它只约束事实索引、审计账本和逻辑隔离边界。
procedure: Confirm the request is about storage, feature-store, dataset manifest, registry, lineage, or audit-ledger boundaries.
Return source evidence, reviewed status, machine gate, applicability, and non-applicability boundaries with the answer.
Route trading signal, position, leverage, stop-loss, take-profit, live execution, or risk-threshold requests to the proper Trading Engineering owner.
Treat this item as reviewed/caveat_only and never as approved default guidance or a hard gate.
anti_patterns: Treating a wide analytical export as the canonical raw/high-frequency store.
Using vector DB, cache, notebook outputs, or log fragments as the canonical registry or audit ledger.
Reading dataset readiness, dataset_hash, or feature availability as model quality, launch permission, or trading permission.
Turning this reviewed/caveat_only item into DDL, migration, database vendor mandate, trade execution advice, default guidance, or hard gate.
validation: source_evidence is non-empty and official/internal contract sources are present.
review.review_status is reviewed and machine_gate.default_guidance is caveat_only.
approved_allowed, default_guidance_allowed, hard_gate_allowed, trade_execution_advice_allowed, and ddl_or_migration_allowed are all false.
MCP/SearchLab/KnowledgeTree can retrieve the item from formal knowledge index after rebuild.
risk_notes: 本条不反对在超大规模或合规隔离场景做物理分区、schema 隔离或多库部署；但这些必须由单独架构任务证明。
本条不替代安全、权限、备份恢复、迁移和 retention 的完整数据库治理知识。
本条不证明某一数据库技术优于其他技术。
物理分库不是默认要求，但在合规隔离、客户密钥、监管边界、地域隔离、超大规模、性能或运维约束成立时可以作为例外设计。
采用物理拆库或 hybrid 架构时，必须定义 tenant isolation policy、cross-database lineage reconciliation、全局 audit trace 和回滚策略。
不得作为默认强制架构。
Reviewed/caveat_only only; not approved and not default guidance.
This item does not create a database, execute a migration, mandate a vendor, or provide trading execution advice.

source_evidence.evidence_summary: CEK-TA internal contract defines canonical records, audit trace, relational facts, dataset manifests and storage governance boundaries.
Feast describes a feature platform that abstracts underlying data infrastructure for training and serving feature access.
Iceberg supports hidden partitioning and partition evolution, illustrating logical/physical decoupling.
KX architecture documentation illustrates specialized data services for high-volume real-time and historical data.
Feast documents a registry as a source of truth for feature definitions and metadata, supporting a central metadata registry pattern.
OpenLineage object model supports job, run and dataset lineage metadata, relevant to cross-store lineage reconciliation.
Azure SQL documents multitenant SaaS design patterns, supporting tenant isolation as an explicit architecture choice rather than a default per-trader database split.
AWS documents bridge-style SaaS tenant isolation, supporting hybrid isolation choices when compliance, scale, or operations require physical separation.

limitations: 中央 registry / audit ledger 字段本体主要来自 CEK-TA 内部契约，需外部审计确认。
外部资料证明逻辑/物理解耦和访问抽象，不直接证明 CEK-TA 的全部字段名。
source_quality_notes: Reviewed/caveat_only: sources support architecture and contract boundaries, not database mandates, trading advice, or model-performance claims.
Official technology and vendor documents are implementation-pattern evidence and must not be treated as mandatory CEK-TA dependencies.
